summary: Black Titan Corporation, a Malaysia-based HCM/ERP software provider listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price notification. On September 2, 2026, Nasdaq informed the company that its ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days through September 1, 2026, violating Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has 180 calendar days, until March 1, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid for 10 consecutive business days. Failure may allow a second 180-day period. No immediate delisting effect; shares continue trading under BTTC. The company is evaluating options to regain compliance. What to watch: potential reverse stock split or other remedial actions before the deadline.
